text: What's with you anyway, $n? You show up here even though you don't have any money. You're just after Ladia.
But you don't have a chance. Ladia doesn't talk to guys without money, no matter how much they may love her.
No harm in trying, right?
Sure I've got no money now, but someday I may be a rich man. You never know.
Aw, forget it kid. You've no idea what you're talking about.
I almost forgot. Your friend, Salim, was just here. Looked like he had some serious things on his mind.
Thanks, I've heard. I was just getting ready to find him.
Ah, good timing! I've got a great proposal for you.
No way. Your 'great proposals' always cause me problems. You even got Salim into trouble the last time.
That reminds me. Salim is looking for you. He headed off to the shipyard in a rush. He looked pretty serious.
Well now, hello there, $n. What can I do for you today? Another deposit?
You have exactly 1000 gold pieces in your account. What's that? You're not depositing...?
Oh, your friend, Salim, was here looking for you. He headed off for the shipyard.
Hello there $n, it looks like you're working hard.
I've been watching you work ever since you were a kid.
So, just stop by whenever you need a rest. I won't charge you for it, so just relax.

|Friend Salim|
Oh there you are, $n! I've been looking all over for you.
What's wrong, Salim? You look upset. This isn't like you at all.
You remember that wreck that drifted into the port yesterday? That was my father's ship. I heard it was a Latin ship, but I never thought...
I quit the navy because I thought I'd be able to help out with my father's business... We bragged about how much money we were going to make...
It looks like I'm all alone now, no family...
Oh, I'm really sorry.
Hey, don't think twice about it. I've been living alone, separated from my parents and sister ever since I was just a lad. I've gotten used to it.
Besides, I'm not alone, and neither are you. We've got each other.
But, what are you doing here?
I had them bring my father's ship here. I couldn't find you, so I had this fellow help me out.
And guess what? He said if we fixed the ship up, we'd be able to use it.
You're not..no..not repairing it, are you? Do you have any idea how much repairs could cost?!
I figured that if I talked to you about it, we'd get the money somehow.
What? Are you crazy? Sure, I've got a little money saved, but it took me forever to save even that. You know that.
Oh, is that ye $n? The ship is still under repairs. It'll take a little while longer.
Ah, I wanted to talk to you about that... How much are the repairs going to cost?
Let's see now... lumber, labor... It all comes to 1000 gold pieces.
There goes my savings...
Eh? Did you say something?
Nothing, sir. Actually, my friend and I here are going to take this ship and go into business.
Your own business, eh?
So, what do you say? Would you consider waiting for payment until we've gotten our business under way?
A delayed payment... OK. I'll go along with that. But, it'll cost you ten times what it does now.. 10,000 in gold.
10,000!? ... well, alright then, we'll accept your terms.
Good then. Work hard though, I want my money... (Sigh) back to repairs then.
See, I knew you'd work something out. But what did you mean by starting a business? What have you got in mind?
Why, trade of course, you simpleton. What other business would you do by ship?
Trade, huh? Well what are we going to do about start-up capital? We can't trade without any money.
We'll get the villagers to give us money. We'll tell them we know of a 'golden business opportunity.'
It'll be a piece of cake! If they show any interest at all, I'll dazzle them with my silver tongue, and then we'll have our money.
Isn't that dishonest?
Not at all. It's all investments. We'll pay them back at least double what they gave us. As long as we have some money to start with, everything'll be alright.
You're pretty smart there. And we can search for your sister along the way.
My long lost sister Sapha... I'd sure like to try and find her.
But I haven't seen her in years. She could be anywhere!
I'm sure we'll find her. We can search the world as we do business.
Well, now that that's decided, we'd better try to round up some cash.
Let's check all the buildings in town.
Go on home, you've got no place here. Go on!
Huh? There doesn't seem to be anybody here. It must be abandoned.
Oh $n, are you here to ask for more work? Too bad, I've got all the help I need right now.
Don't you think it's about time you found yourself a steady job? Then again, I suppose you wouldn't be able to handle that, would you?
Salim was in here looking for you. Looked like he had something pretty important on his mind. He went off in the direction of the shipyard.
Don't hesitate to come by if you've got any problems. I'd be happy to help. I try to keep up with all the new happenings in town.
I'm looking forward to your return, as a rich man of course.
Listen, I've got a great business proposition for you.
A great business proposition? Why should I trust you?
Hmph, here I come with a great business deal for you and you just turn me away. Oh well, your loss. Let's go find someone else Salim.
Too bad... you could have been rich.

|Waitress at the Pub|
Wait a minute. How about telling me what your deal is?
Oh, hello there Ladia. Sure, I'll tell you.
My friend and I here just got our hands on a ship. And we figured we'd go into the trading business.
Right, trading. $n here has a real head for it.
But if we're going to trade, it's best to start with a good amount of cash.
How about it? Would you like to make an investment? If you give me 1000 gold pieces now, I promise you'll get back tenfold.
Sounds intriguing. I've managed to save up a little money while working here at the pub.
If you really can increase my money like you say, then I'll give you my savings. Here's my 1000 gold pieces.
You can count on me. I promise I'll be back with your money!
You'd better pay me back, or I'll never forgive you!
You're not used to sailing, so I suggest you don't try to travel too far at first.
And you've got to hire some sailors, or you won't even make it out of the harbor.
It's also a good idea to load as much food and water as you can. Keep in mind that the winds and currents can cause unexpected delays.
Thanks for the advice. I'll be back soon with your money, 10 times what you gave me - 10,000 in gold!
Ah, you caught me at a good time. I've got a business proposition for you.
No way. Your 'great proposals' always get me into trouble. You even caused Salim a load of trouble last time.
Besides, I've got a better deal for you. Care to hear about it?
A better deal? Alright, I'm in!
Wait a minute. I haven't even told you yet. Oh well, If you loan me 1000 gold pieces I'll turn it into 10,000!
1000 into 10,000... Tenfold?
Salim and I are going to trade our way to riches.
Trade? You're going to do business? You've certainly got a head for numbers... it just might work.
Of course it'll work! And you'll get 10 times the original amount... piece of cake!
O.K. then, here's my 1000.
I sure hope you pull this off. Remember: 'Buy low, sell high.'
I will. And you'll be sure to get 10,000 gold pieces in return.

|Banker Radino|
Hello there $n. Have you come to make another deposit?
Nope. I've come to withdraw all my money.
I see. Here's the balance of your account, 1000 gold pieces. Please make sure it's all there.
What made you decide to withdraw your savings? Has something come up?
I've decided to start trading.
Trade, eh? I have a feeling you'll make a great trader.
Do you know the basics of trade? 'Buy 'em low, sell 'em high.' That's the key.
That's common sense.
You're right there, but the most common of principals can be the hardest to use. How do you plan to buy low and sell high?
Hmmm. Well, first I thought I'd stock up on carpets here in Istanbul and then sell them in Athens.
After I sell the carpets in Athens, I'll buy art there and sell it here in Istanbul.
I see. Carpets from Istanbul. Art from Athens. Both are specialty goods particular to each area.
In short, you're going to make a trade route between two ports, Istanbul and Athens.
Exactly. You know quite a bit about trade for a banker.
Oh, no. I learned that from the head of this bank, Master Howell.
Master Howell started out as a mere trader like you. But now he has banks all over the world.
Now, here is my personal investment in you, 1000 gold pieces.
A personal investment? You're a banker, aren't you?
Of course. And because I'm a banker, I like the interest you're offering. As long as you have money to start, I'm sure that you'll succeed.
You really know how to flatter a guy. And I'll return 10,000 in gold, 10 times what you gave me.
10 times? I'm counting on you.
Huh? There's no one here. He must be out working on the repairs.
I wonder how much longer it'll take? Oh well, let's go see if we can't round up any more gold.
This is no place for you. Go on, go home.
But I have a business prop...
I don't care. Now go!
Say, I've got a really good proposition for you. Care to hear it?
Oh, that's probably all I'll be able to do, but please, tell me anyway.
I managed to get my hands on a ship. Salim and I decided we would use that ship and start trading.
What would you say to investing in us? I've offered other people a profit of ten times their investment, but just for you, I offer to return 20 times the original amount.
So, you finally got a ship, eh? I'm glad to hear it. I always thought you'd make something of yourself someday.
Hmmm, please take this money. You don't have to return it. I just thought that even a little bit would help you get started.

Accept
Refuse
Alright then, I accept your offer.
Good. If you don't think that way you'll never make any money. Use it as capital and go make a million.
I'm sorry, I can't take your money.
That's too bad. Well then, take this cat along with you. It's pretty smart. It'll catch a lot of mice for you.
I don't know how to thank you.
Huh? This house looks empty.
No one lives there now. It's been on the market for some time, but nobody's come forward to buy it.
Say, have I got a deal for you.
A deal? Forget it. I wouldn't deal with you if you were the last person on the earth.
Hmph, here I came all this way just to help you make a profit, and you won't even listen. Come on Salim, let's get out of here.
Too bad... we could've made you rich.
Don't hesitate to stop by and chat. I try to know everything that goes on in this town.
I'm looking forward to you coming back as a rich man.
Before you depart, I think you ought to go to the pub and try to recruit some sailors. You can't sail a ship with just two men you know.
It's also a good idea to stock up on food and water. The wind and currents can really slow a ship down, it may take longer than you think to get to a port.
Thanks for the tip. You can rest assured I'll bring back your money.
I sure hope you succeed. Remember: 'Buy low, sell high.'
Thanks. You can count on me for your 10,000!
Hello there, $n. The people in this town don't think too highly of you, but don't give up, sonny.
Come back a rich man one day, that'll be your revenge. I'll be rooting for you.
You're fairly new to sailing so take it slow at first. Don't try to go too far.
If your ship has any problems, be sure to get it fixed right away.
It's also a good idea to buy some supplies. If you have some lumber, you can disembark anywhere and fix your ship yourself.
Oh, how long have you guys been here? Oh well, your ship's ready.
Well, good luck. And don't forget to pay me back!
I guess we need to think of a name for our ship.
How about 'Savahni'? It means 'Friends.'
That's a great name! O.K. Salim, let's go!
Savahni
This is no place for peasants. Go on, get out of here.
If you invest, I'll increase it 10 times...
You heard me! Get out of here!
Huh? Doesn't look like anybody lives here.
It's vacant. It's been on the market for quite a while, but no one's bought it yet.
Hey friend, have I got a deal for you.
A deal? Not the 'How about investing some money? I'm going to start trading. Pay you back 10 fold' spiel, I hope. I've heard that one already, and I don't think you can do it.
But give it a try anyway. I want to see you apologize to all the folks that trusted you.
Oh, $n, you came. I'm glad you made it.
I asked several people, but no one knew anything about the girl Sapha.
I'm sorry. It doesn't look like I was much help.
Don't be ridiculous. I appreciate your efforts.
Hey $n! I heard that you've been given a title.
Now that you're a noble, you'll be given various new rights and permissions, not like we commoners.
Oh, you had asked me to find out about Sapha, right?
Did you find anything out?
No, not yet. No one's even heard of her.
Oh, that's too bad. Listen, I'm really sorry I asked such a tough favor.
Don't mention it. Glad I could help.
Oh, $n, what can I do for you? Have you managed to make a bit of money?
Uh-oh, it doesn't look like you've had too much luck yet.
Wow, you've really made a profit. Do you think you could pay me back now?
Not just yet. Can you wait just a little longer? I'm going to make even more money!
Really?! In that case, I don't mind waiting.
Sure. Sorry to keep you waiting so long.
Really?! Oh, I'm so happy! Smooch.
Hey now! Cut that ou...
I never thought you'd actually earn me this much money. I've really misjudged you.
But don't get me wrong. It's not because you're a rich man now.
Everyone here thinks that I'm only interested in rich men. But that's not true.
I like men with talent. Their wealth doesn't really matter. Actually, I hate men who just spend their time wasting their parent's money.
But you really are good at trading. I think it's the perfect job for you.
One favor. Whenever you come back to this port, be sure to stop by the pub. I'll be waiting.
O... OK. That reminds me. You said you're quite an information gatherer right?
That's right. Here at the pub, I hear things without even trying.
Have you ever heard anything about a woman named Sapha?
Sapha? Who's that?! Do you like her?! Are you married!?
No, no. She's my younger sister. We were separated when I was very young, but I've never stopped looking for her.
Oh, your sister. In that case, leave it to me. I'll ask the sailors that stop by.
Thanks Ladia.
Hey $n, heard of any good deals?
The world isn't full of golden opportunities, you know.
You're right about that! But if you hear anything good, be sure to let me know, OK?
Hey $n... I mean, greetings, Master $n.
Why the sudden politeness?
Well, I heard that you've become a noble. Congratulations.
Now that my lord's gained nobility, you have special privileges that we laymen don't.
So I can't talk to you, $n, uh..my lord, like I used to.
Oh, don't think twice about it. Just act the way you've always acted.
Whew. I think I'll take you up on your offer.
If I hear of any good deals, I'll let you know.
Hey $n, how're things going? Manage to make any money yet?
Hmmm, I guess not, by the looks of it.
Wow, you've really done well for yourself. Maybe you could return my money now, with interest of course.
Can you wait a little longer?
I guess so. Good luck! Make lots of money!
Sure, I can pay you now.
Wow. I'm going to use this money to relax, maybe even take a vacation.
Ahoy, there, don't be taking off just yet. You still have a customer here.
A customer? Come on, quit your joking.
Say now, I like what I see there. Is that 10,000 in cash?
How about lending it to me for a while?
No way!
Just a minute. Who do you think you are?

|Pietro Conti|
Huh? Me? Why I'm Pietro, a famous, er, somewhat famous, adventurer. And yourself?
I'm $n, a trader.
Really? So you're $n. I've heard of you.
Which reminds me... I had a favor to ask you. Would you loan me some money?
Do you plan on paying me back?
Of course, mate! I do have a sponsor, you know. All I have to do is discover some new little trinket somewhere and I'll get quite a sum of money.
Now that you mention it, I do remember hearing something about the Duchess of Lisbon sponsoring an adventurer named Pietro.
So, what do you say? Will you lend me some money?
No, I don't think so. I don't trust you. Sorry, but you'll have to find somebody else to borrow money from.
Oh, is that so?! You'll regret it, you skinflint!
Well then, I guess you're good for it.
Thanks, matey. I'll pay you back soon.
Just in case, why don't you tell me your sponsor's name.
You're an untrusting sort, aren't you? Oh well, it's the Duchess Franco in Lisbon.
Alright then. Make sure you remember to return my money!
Welcome $n, how's business?
Greeting Master $n, I heard you were made a noble. My congratulations.
Now that you've got a title, you'll get all sorts of rights and privileges.
I heard that if you trade with ports that have allied with your own country, you can buy goods cheaply.
$n, how are you? Have you been able to make a profit?
Doesn't look like you made enough to pay me back yet.
I knew you'd be a success! Now how about my money? 10,000 gold pieces, as you remember.
Can you hold on a little longer?
Sure, I can wait. Keep up the good work.
I have it right here.
It seems my decision to invest in you was wise, after all.
I owe my success to you. Your advice, the story about the head of Marco Polo bank, really inspired me.
Actually, Master Howell is in town. Would you like to meet him?
Like to? I'd love to.
OK. Just a minute.

|President of Marco Polo Bank|
So you're $n, the trader. I'm Howell.
It's a pleasure to meet you sir. $n $s, at your service.
I've heard quite a bit about you. You took a wrecked ship, repaired it and started trading. Reminds me of me when I was young.
Really? I want to be a millionaire some day, so I'm going to learn as much as I can from your example.
The road to riches is not an easy one, my friend. And a million isn't all it's cracked up to be. It all seems kind of empty, sometimes.
You've got to be kidding!?
Well, I don't suppose you can understand that now. So give it your best shot.
Say $n, how's your ship doing? If you have any problems, just let me know. I'll fix 'er right up.
What do you say? Would you like to buy a used ship off my hands?
How about buying a new ship?
Well if it isn't $n! Welcome Master $n.
I heard you've been given a title. Congratulations!
Now that you're a noble, you'll have plenty of privileges we commonfolk don't enjoy.
Why don't you take this opportunity to buy yourself a new ship?
Hey $n, how's business? Making any money?
Hmmm. Doesn't look like you managed to make too much yet.
Hey, you've done pretty good for yourself. How about paying me back?
Sorry, but can you wait a little longer?
As long as you haven't forgotten. Sure, I can wait.
OK, I can do that.
Thanks! Let me share with you a nice little tidbit I've learned.
You've been trading for a while, so you probably know this already, but if you find you're carrying around quite a bit of money, it's a good idea to invest some in a port.
If you ally with a port, they will sell goods to you cheap. And the higher your rank, the bigger the discount you'll get.
You can invest in either the marketplace or the shipyard, so think carefully before you spend your money.
If you invest in the marketplace, then they'll have capital to expand, and they'll start to sell a lot of goods they never used to stock.
It's much the same with the shipyard. Investment means they'll be able to build better ships, make better repairs and offer a better selection of used ships.
But be careful about investing in foreign ports you're allied with. Sometimes, other traders may get jealous and come after you.
Thank you. I'm sure your advice will prove very useful.
Huh? It doesn't look like anyone lives here.
No one does. It's vacant. It's been on the market for a while, but nobody's bought it yet.
Hi there $n! How's business?
Make sure that some day you get even with the nasty people who said you were a big nothing.
I'm so happy for you $n. I heard that you've been given a title.
Oh, I forgot. I should call you Master $n, shouldn't I?
Forget about it. No reason to treat me special.
Of course there is. I'm really happy for you.
Hey $n. You're not still trading, are you?
You've got no head for that kind, any kind, of business so why don't you just give up?
$n! How is everything? Are you making any money?
Hum, you've made quite a bit of money. But it doesn't matter, because in the end you'll wind up with nothing. I'm sure of it.
Just as I thought. You're no good at this either. But, go on and keep on trying if you want.
M-M-M-Master $n. Welcome to my humble shop.
What's wrong with you? You're acting completely different.
Of course I am. You've become a noble now, that's why.
Here in the Ottoman Empire, the difference between a commoner and a noble is like the ground and the sky.
Please, forgive my rude behavior.
Oh, $n. A messenger from the palace was just here. He said he was looking for you.
It seems Sultan Suleiman II the Magnificent has something he wants to discuss with you.
Welcome, Master $n.
A messenger from the palace was just here looking for you, sir.
I think it would be wise to head for the castle.

|Suleiman II|
I'm glad you made it, $n $s.
Your Highness.
I wonder if you wouldn't assist me in a particular manner.
I will do anything the Sultan requests.
Good. The Turkish nation has a long history as one of the more culturally advanced people of the world.
But the various countries of Europe think that they are superior and have begun to widen their holdings in foreign lands.
In order to deal with those countries directly, we must increase the power of our nation.
As we increase our influence, I think the best way to reduce the power of other countries would be to put the ports of the world under our grasp.
Right now, we have alliances with $d16 ports, but this number must grow.
The problem is this. It takes money to make alliances. It's not that we don't have money, but we must also think about strengthening our military forces.
That's why I'm giving you 50 gold ingots.
Use your trading skills to increase my money. Then take that money and form alliances with the ports of the world. Do you think you can do it?
I understand. I will undertake this task at once.
Good. Here's your gold.
Oh, I also have another gift for you. A tax-free permit.
As long as you have this, you won't be charged for taxes at ports allied with the Turkish Empire.
But remember that you must renew it every April and October. Don't forget.
You are too kind, your Highness.
Still no one living here?
It's been on the market forever it seems. I wonder why no one's bought it?
Welcome Master $n.
A palace guard was just here looking for you.
Hello there $n. I'm so glad you stopped by to visit again.
But I still haven't heard anything about Sapha. I'm sorry.
No reason to apologize. Don't worry. I plan to search for her for as long as it takes.
Hey $n... I mean Master $n.
By the way, did you know that the Sultan is preparing for war? There's been some unsettling movement around the coast of Africa, near the Red Sea.
I heard that there is some mysterious secret technology hidden in the port of Massawa, that surpassed that of the European countries as well.
I'm all in favor of increasing the Turkish Empire and increasing business.
Just recently, I started levying taxes in order to help pay for the war. I'm working hard for the cause.
I've already heard that line. It seems like everybody's talking, but no one's acting.
Well, I just wanted to say my piece. Doesn't anybody have any good ideas to make some quick money?
Doesn't anyone have any good money making schemes?
Welcome Master $n. It looks like business is going well.
Do you happen to have your tax-free license with you?
It's always good to have tax-free licenses from other countries too. That way you can buy duty free at allied ports as well.
But be careful. Don't forget to renew them every April and October.
Master $n. What a pleasant surprise.
Is your ship holding up alright? If you need any repairs just ask.
Oh, if you've got some extra cash, you should think about buying a warship for protection. There are pirates out there, you know.
Master $n, you look tired. Why not rest here for a spell.
This house is still vacant?! Why doesn't anyone buy it?
Wouldn't it be great to live in a house like this?
We don't need a house. We're rough and tough seafaring men. What more could you ask for?
Welcome, welcome Master $n.
I hear that business is booming. That's wonderful.
I always said that $n would be rich someday. Told everyone he'd rise above his birth class.
Of course I'm not lying. Well, maybe I did say some pretty mean things in the past, but...
Exactly, I was just trying to motivate you, Master $n. Please believe me!
Hi again, $n. I'm glad you could make it.
Just a minute, OK. I was talking to a customer... Oh, here he is. Let me introduce you. Joao!
Joao, this is the man I told you about earlier, $n.

|Joao Franco|
Pleased to make your acquaintance. I am Joao Franco of Portugal.
I've heard that you are a trader. Ladia always talks about you... only about you, it seems.
Ladia has been so very kind to me. You see, I was attacked by pirates, but she helped nurse me back to health.
Attacked by pirates? That sounds like quite an ordeal.
Some piratess named Catalina thinks I sunk her brother's ship or something, and now she's out to get me. But I've never even seen her before!
She's probably still lying in wait for me somewhere. I can't leave this port like this.
But I have to find the secret of Atlantis as soon as possible.
Secret of Atlantis? What's that?
Well, Atlantis was a land that possessed technology far superior to anything we know today.
Oh, that's no secret. I know where that is.
What?! What do you mean, you know where Atlantis is? It sunk into the ocean ages ago!
If you're referring to the secret land with technology far superior to that of Europe, I know where it is.
It's in the port of Massawa on the African coast near the Red Sea.
Rumor has it that the original settlers of that city journeyed many miles, after their home was swallowed by an earthquake.
But I don't think their secret technology will be a secret much longer. The Sultan Suleiman II the Magnificent is trying to seize control of that port.
If that's the case, I can't just sit around here. I've got to get to Massawa!
But Catalina, your pirate friend, is out there waiting for you. You need a scheme to get out of here.
Tell you what. I'll go in your place, as a decoy.
A decoy? So while you've got her attention, I can slip past and escape.
As long as we put the sail with my emblem on your ship, Catalina will probably think that you're me and chase you.
Wow, you're pretty smart.
You're not too bad yourself. But that puts you in a dangerous position.
Hey, don't worry about it. But I have a favor to ask of you as well. I want you to look for somebody.
O.K. that sounds pretty easy. Who?
My sister, Sapha. We were separated when I was just a boy. She should be about 16 or 17 now.
Do you have anything else to go on?
I'm afraid not.
No? Oh, well. I'll give it a go. If I do find her, should I get in touch with you here?
Just leave a message with Ladia.
$n, don't go and do anything too dangerous now.
Don't worry.
Well now, if it's not $n! I mean Master $n. How may I help you?
Have you heard? A few days ago a Portuguese ship, chased by pirates, fled into this port.
The captain was a young, handsome fellow. He's been at the lodge, healing his wounds. Seems that Ladia was taking care of him.
Everyone's saying that Ladia is head over heels for him.
I'd be worried if I were you, $n. You might lose Ladia to that Portuguese fellow.
Stop joking around Salim. Ladia would never... Well, let's go to the pub anyway!
O.K. then, I'm going to put my emblem sail on your ship.
Alright, I'm finished. Take care of Catalina for me. But be careful!
You too! Find my sister Sapha for me!
How may I help you, Master $n?
Have you heard? There's a Portuguese ship seeking refuge in the harbor after being attacked by pirates.
Oh, and the captain. So young and handsome. Why, Ladia's been over at the lodge for the past several days now looking after his wounds.
Rumor is that she's taken a liking to the man.
$n, aren't you a little bit worried? What if that Portuguese sailor steals Ladia away from you?
Knock it off. Ladia would never... Come on! We're going to the pub!
$n! I mean Master $n, it's just terrible!
What? What's got you looking so distraught?
I think Ladia's falling in love with a Portuguese sailor who's been staying here!
He was attacked by pirates and badly hurt, but Ladia has been at his side tending to his wounds.
Now he's up and about again, and gone to the pub with Ladia!
Master $n, if you sit here wasting your time with me, you might lose Ladia forever.
Welcome Master $n.
Have you heard the news? There's a Portuguese ship staying in the harbor. Seems that it fled here after being attacked by pirates.
